about: What Ozi says to everyday words (ruling 34). Added to every day (50 a day, ruling 44) by a scheduled task, checked by the tests before it goes live. Each entry: an id, a topic, the words people say ('when'), and replies, one chosen in turn. In replies, {assistant} becomes Ozi's name, {product} the product's name, {motto} the motto, and {fee}, {smallFee}, {smallUpTo}, {memberFee}, {plusFee}, {itemCharge}, {membership}, {plusPrice}, {familyPrice}, {orgClient}, {maximum}, {maximumProduct}, {runnerPay}, {callPrice} and {instantRefund} the figures from config/store.json, so a price is never written here. Ozi only uses these when nothing about an order or the basket was meant, and only when the whole sentence is one of the 'when' phrases or Ozi was called by name.

replies: You're welcome. {motto}
My pleasure. Is there anything else you need?
Any time. Just say my name when you need me.
Hello. What shopping can I get for you today?
Hello there. Would you like to order something?
Hi. {motto} What would you like?
I'm very well, thank you for asking. What can I get for you today?
I'm good, and ready to help with your shopping. What would you like?
Goodbye. I'm here whenever you need shopping.
Bye for now. Just say my name when you need me again.
No problem at all. Take your time.
That's all right. What would you like to do?
I'm {assistant}, your shopping assistant. {motto} Tell me what you need, and a Runner will bring it to your door.
My name is {assistant}. I take your shopping order by voice, and a Runner shops for it and brings it to you.
I can take your shopping order, read your basket back, tell you the total, and tell you where your Runner is. Just say, for example, I'd like bread and milk.
Tell me the shopping you need, and I'll put it in your basket and send it when you say yes. You can also ask what's in your basket, or where your order is.

Delivery is {smallFee} for shopping of {smallUpTo} or less, and {fee} above that, if you pay as you go. Members pay {memberFee} every time, and Plus {plusFee}. You pay what the till says for the shopping itself.
It's {smallFee} up to {smallUpTo} of shopping and {fee} above, on pay as you go; {memberFee} for members; {plusFee} on Plus. {runnerPay} of it always goes to your Runner.

when: what's the most i can order
replies: One order carries up to {maximum} of shopping, and no single product can cost more than {maximumProduct}. More than that goes as a second delivery.
A Runner is a checked local person who buys your shopping at the shop and brings it to your door. Their right to work and background are checked before they take any job.

when: can i speak to my runner
replies: Yes. On Your order, there's a big green Call button once a Runner has your order. Calls cost {callPrice} a minute, and nobody's phone number is ever shared.
As soon as a Runner accepts your order, they go to the shop, do your shopping, and bring it straight to you. I'll tell you each step as it happens.

when: what if they don't have it
what if it's out of stock
replies: If something isn't on the shelf, your Runner asks you in the app. Nothing is ever swapped without your say, and if you don't answer, it's left out and you're not charged for it.
You save a card once, and it's charged when you send an order. You pay what the shop's till says, the item charges, and delivery. Nothing is charged without your yes.
Your card goes straight to Stripe, the payment company. We never see or keep the card number, only the last four numbers so I can tell you which card it is.
Not at the moment. Every order is paid by a card saved first, so your Runner never handles money at your door.
I'm sorry, we can't deliver alcohol, tobacco, medicines or cash. Everything else from the shop, I can help with.
You can change your address in Your addresses, in Settings. To keep your account safe, it needs your four-number PIN.
I'm sorry, I can't see or say your PIN, so it stays safe. Please ring us, and a person will help you set a new one.
To cancel, please ring us before your Runner starts shopping, and we'll cancel it and refund you in full.
I'm sorry about that. Go to Past orders and choose Report a problem. {instantRefund} or less is refunded straight away, and anything more is decided by a person within two working days.
Good choice. Fruit like bananas and apples, vegetables like carrots and broccoli, wholemeal bread, eggs, oats and yoghurt are all good. Shall I add any of those?
For a healthy basket, try porridge oats, fresh fruit, frozen vegetables, beans and wholemeal bread. Just tell me which you'd like.
For breakfast, porridge oats with a banana, wholemeal toast with eggs, or yoghurt and fruit are all good. Shall I add any?
Five a day is easy with a mix: bananas, apples, carrots, peas and tomatoes. Tinned and frozen count too. Which would you like?
Good value staples are rice, pasta, porridge oats, tinned beans, tinned tomatoes, eggs and frozen vegetables. Shall I add some of those?
For the basics, many people choose milk, bread, eggs, butter and bananas. Tell me which you'd like, and how many.
Your Runner shops at our listed shop, and you pay the shelf price. More shops are coming.
You can. On the first screen choose I look after someone, or add their address in Your addresses, with your PIN, and send the order there.

when: how do i become a runner
i want to be a runner
replies: You can sign up as a Runner in the app, from the first screen. You'll be asked for a photo, your right to work and a DBS check, and then you can take jobs near you.
Sorry. You can choose a different voice in Settings, and if you miss anything, just say repeat.
Of course. You can ring us, and a person will help. Ask me for the phone number and I'll read it out.
Thank you, that's kind. {motto}
Thank you. Is there anything else I can get for you?
I can't see the weather, but if it's a day for staying in, I can bring the shopping to you. What would you like?
I'm sorry to hear that. I'm always here to help with your shopping. Perhaps a treat, or something nice for tea? Just tell me.

when: what can i have for tea
replies: How about something easy, like pasta with tinned tomatoes, beans on toast, or eggs and bread? Shall I add any of those?

{assistant} Plus is {plusPrice} a month: delivery at {plusFee}, your regular Runner where possible, priority at busy times, no adverts, and everything in Membership. You choose to join, and can cancel at any time.
A membership with Recipes and Finds It included.
Say what can I cook, and I'll open the recipes.
Say what can I cook.
Say a present, and I'll show the little gifts.
Say a present, and I'll open them.
Say I can't find it anywhere, and a person will look in up to three shops.
Say I can't find it anywhere.
Say gift card to buy one or use one.
Say gift card.
Say set up my weekly shop, and choose a day.
Say set up my weekly shop.
Say same as last time, and I'll put your last order back in the basket.
Say same as last time.
Usually the same day. Ask me where's my order any time.
Same day, usually.
Choosing a time slot isn't available yet. Your Runner comes as soon as they can.
Not yet. As soon as possible.
No, payment is taken by card when you order. A family member or carer can add the card for you.
Card only, when you order.
Yes, Apple Pay and Google Pay work too.
Both work.
Your card is kept by Stripe, never by us.
Stripe keeps it safe.
Say change my address, or choose another saved address at the checkout.
You can pick a different saved address when you check out.
Your PIN protects your addresses, so nobody can send your shopping elsewhere.
It protects your addresses.
Ring us and we'll close it. Nothing is deleted straight away, in case you change your mind.
Ring us, and we'll help.
It's optional, in Settings, and helps us understand what people need. Never shown to anyone.
Optional, and private.
If an organisation supports you, type their code in Settings to let them see your orders.
Type their code in Settings.

when: i don't know what to do
replies: That's all right. Say I'd like, then what you need, like I'd like bread and milk.
Just tell me what you'd like.

when: can a family member help me
replies: Yes. Family can help add your card, or order with you.
Of course.
Fruit, vegetables, porridge and lentils are good, cheap and easy. Say what can I cook for ideas.
Try porridge, lentil soup or fruit. Say what can I cook.
I can't give medical advice, but I can find lower sugar foods. Tell me what you'd like.
Ask your doctor for advice. I'll find what you need.
I'm sorry. Your Runner will be happy to say hello, and if you need someone to talk to, organisations like Age UK are there.
I'm here to help. Age UK can be a friendly voice too.
If it's an emergency, call 999. For advice, call 111. I can bring your shopping.
Call 111 for advice, or 999 in an emergency.
Ask me for fruit or vegetables, and I'll find what's there today.
Ask for fruit or veg.
Tell me what you need and I'll read the prices.
Say what you need and I'll give prices.
You can set a spending limit in your account, so no order goes over it.
Yes, in your account.
Prices are estimates. You pay what the till says.
You pay what the till says.
Say local shops, and I'll open shops showing their own products.
Local shops have their own pages.
Say any offers, and I'll tell you what's on.
Say any offers.
Yes, everyday essentials like batteries and light bulbs come the same day. Say I'd like batteries.
Say I'd like, then what you need.
Every Runner is checked, with a DBS. They'll say who they are at the door.
Checked and kind.
Yes, with the call button on your order page. Your numbers stay private.
Use the call button.
If you'd like, ask them. They'll help as you wish.
Ask them, they'll help.
Say report a problem, or use the button on your past orders.
Report it from your past orders.
I'm sorry. Report a problem from your past orders. Small refunds are given at once.
Report it, and small refunds are instant.
Pinch the screen to zoom in, or use your phone's text size setting.
Pinch to zoom.
The app uses strong contrast. Your phone's settings can change colours too.
High contrast already.
Add this website to your home screen now. The phone apps are coming soon.
Add to home screen for now.
I'm not a person. I'm {assistant}, the {product} assistant. The Runners are real people.
I'm an assistant, not a person.
{product} was founded by someone registered blind, who wanted shopping to be easy for everyone.
A blind founder, for everyone.
We start in Medway, Kent, and are growing.
Medway, Kent.
Yes. Say I'd like to be a Runner, or open the Runner page from the first screen.
Open the Runner page.
That's very kind. I'm happy to help.
Thank you. Happy to help.
Your Runner brings your shopping in bags, and chilled things in a cool bag.
Yes, your shopping comes in bags.
Of course. I'll wait.
Take your time.
You can order any time. Runners deliver while shops are open.
Order any time.
Share the website with friends. Your share link is in Settings.
Your share link is in Settings.
Your phone's speech settings can make me faster.
Change the speed in your phone's settings.
Choose a voice in Settings.
Pick a voice in Settings.
Yes, I can hear you.
Loud and clear.

when: how do i talk to you
how do i speak to you
replies: Just talk to me as you would to a friend. Say what you need, like bread and milk, and I'll put it in your basket.
Speak normally, and take your time. Tell me the shopping you need, and I'll do the rest.
Yes, I'm here and listening. What shopping can I help with?
I'm here. Tell me what you need.

when: what can i say to you
replies: You can say what you'd like to buy, ask what's in your basket, ask the total, or ask where your order is. Plain words are fine.
Try saying the things you need, one after another. For example, bananas, eggs and tea bags.

when: how do i wake you up
how do i get your attention
replies: Press my round green button, or say my name. When the button glows, I'm listening.
Say my name, or press the big green button on the side of the screen. Then tell me what you need.
My button is big, round and green. It starts in the middle of the right-hand edge of the screen. Press it, and tell me what you need.
Look on the right-hand side of the screen for a big round green button. It glows when I'm listening.

when: the button is in the way
your button is in the way
replies: Yes. Hold my green button and drag it where you'd like it. With a keyboard, the arrow keys move it too.
Of course. Press and hold the button, then slide it somewhere more comfortable.
Press my green button once, or say mute. I'll stop listening until you press it again.
Say mute, or press my button. When you want me back, press the button again.

when: do you record what i say
do you listen all the time
replies: No. I only use your words to help with your shopping, and when muted I'm not listening at all. What can I get for you?
I'm only here to help you shop. If you'd like me to stop listening, just say mute or press my button.

when: how do i turn your voice off
how do i stop you talking
how do i make you quiet
can you stop talking out loud
replies: Use the switch at the bottom of the screen, say turn off talking, or go to Settings. My words stay written on the screen.
Say turn off talking, and I'll go quiet. To hear me again, say hey {assistant}, turn on.

when: how do i turn your voice back on
how do i hear you again
replies: Say hey {assistant}, turn on, or use the switch at the bottom of the screen, or Settings.
Use the talking switch at the bottom of the screen, and I'll speak aloud again.
I'm sorry. Please say it again, a little slower, and I'll try once more.
Sorry about that. Try saying just the item and how many, like two loaves of bread.
I'm sorry, and thank you for your patience. Short sentences help me, one item at a time. You can also tap on the screen if that's easier.
I'm sorry. Let's go slowly. Tell me one thing you need, and I'll check it with you.
Please turn up your phone's volume with the buttons on its side. If you miss anything, just say repeat.
Try the volume buttons on the side of your phone. And you can always say repeat.
Please turn the volume down with the buttons on the side of your phone. What shopping can I help with?
The volume buttons on your phone will make me quieter. Then just tell me what you need.
I speak English for now. Welsh and other languages are planned. What can I get for you today?
Just English at the moment, but more languages are on the way. How can I help with your shopping?
I'm a shopping assistant, here to help you get what you need. What would you like today?
I'm good at shopping, and that's what I'm here for. What can I find for you?
I'm always ready to help with your shopping, day or night. What do you need?
No rest needed. Is there anything you'd like to order?

when: can i use the screen instead
replies: Of course. Everything works with the screen too. Use the search on the shop page and tap Add.
You don't have to talk. Tap and type whenever you like, and I'll still be here if you want me.

when: can i do it all by voice
can i shop without the screen
replies: Yes. You can do the whole order by talking to me. I'll read your basket back, say the address, and only send it when you say yes.
Yes, everything can be done by voice. Tell me what you need, and I'll guide you step by step.
Of course. If anything goes too fast, just say repeat, and I'll say it again in different words.
Sorry. Say repeat any time, and I'll go over it again.
If I've got it, I'll read it back to you. If not, please say it once more.
I'll always check with you before anything is sent. Please say it again if you're not sure.

when: tell me what you can do
replies: I can take your order, read back the basket, give the total, track your Runner, find recipes, and look for things that are hard to find. What would you like first?
As well as the shopping, there's Recipes, Little Gifts, Finds It, gift cards and a weekly shop. Say any of those to hear more.
Welcome. It's easy. Tell me what you need, I'll read it back, and when you say yes a Runner shops for it and brings it to your door.
Welcome. Take it slowly. Just tell me one thing you'd like, and we'll go from there.
It's made to be easy, especially for people who can't see the screen well. Just talk to me, and I'll guide you.
You'll manage fine. Tell me what you need, and I'll do the rest and check everything with you.
Start by telling me one thing you need, like milk or bread. I'll add it to your basket and ask what else.
First, make sure you have an account with a card saved. Then just tell me your shopping.
I can't describe the page itself, but I can help you shop by voice. Say basket to hear your basket, or tell me what you need.
Your phone's screen reader can read the page to you. Or just tell me what you'd like, and I'll do it.
Tap Shop at the top of the screen to go back to the shop. Then tell me what you need.
The Shop tab takes you back to the start. What would you like?
Settings is in the menu at the top of the screen. There you'll find your addresses, my voice, and Show words on the screen.
Look for Settings in the menu. Is there something there I can help you with?
The More page has Recipes, Little Gifts, Finds It, your weekly shop, gift cards and the plans. Say any of those to hear about it.
On More you'll find the extras, like Recipes and Little Gifts. Which would you like to hear about?

when: is it a website or an app
replies: For now it's a website you can add to your home screen. The phone apps are coming soon. Shall we do some shopping?
It works in your phone's browser today, and the phone apps are on their way.

when: you can't hear me on my iphone
replies: On an iPhone, Chrome has worked best for listening. Please make sure the microphone is allowed for this website.
If I can't hear you, check the microphone is allowed in your browser. On an iPhone, try Chrome.

when: why do i have to tap
replies: A web browser won't let a website make a sound until the page is touched once. Tap anywhere, and I'll speak.
Just one tap anywhere on the screen lets me speak. The phone apps won't need it.
I'm here and working. If something seems stuck, try closing the page and opening it again. Then tell me what you need.
I'm working fine. What would you like to do? You can ask for shopping or your basket.
I'm sorry. A weak signal can slow things down. Try moving nearer your Wi-Fi, or close and open the page again.
Sorry about that. Please try again in a moment. Your basket stays saved.

when: how do i update the app
replies: The website updates by itself, so there's nothing to do. Just open it and tell me what you need.
No need. You always get the newest version when you open it.
Yes, you need an internet connection, by Wi-Fi or mobile data. It doesn't use much.
You need to be online to order, by Wi-Fi or mobile data.
Yes. You can ring our number, and I'll answer and take your order by telephone. Ask me for the phone number and I'll read it out.
You can order by ringing us. I answer the phone too, and take your shopping item by item.

when: does it work on a tablet
does it work on a laptop
replies: Yes. It works on a phone, a tablet or a computer, in the web browser. Shall we start your shopping?
Yes, any of those will do. Just open the website.

when: do i have to sign up
replies: You can look around without one. To order, you need an account with a card saved, so a Runner can be sent.
Looking is free. When you're ready to order, I can open an account with you just by talking.

when: how do i make an account
how do i open an account
replies: Say open account, and I'll ask your name, your mobile number, your address and what to do at the door. Nothing is made until you say yes.
Just say open account. We'll do it together by talking, and I'll read everything back.
There's no password. You sign in with your phone number or email, and a code we send you.
No password needed. To sign in, say sign in, and I'll send a code to your phone.
Say sign in. I'll ask for your phone number, send a code by text, or ring a landline with it, and you say the six numbers back.
Say sign in, and I'll guide you. You'll get a six-number code to say or type.
Please wait a minute, then check your texts again. If it still hasn't come, say sign in to try once more.
Sorry. Check the number was right, and give it a moment. You can ask for another code by starting again.
You can use whichever you have. A landline works too: we ring it and say the code aloud.
Phone number or email, both are fine. A landline gets the code by an automatic call.
Say sign me out, or press Sign out in Settings.
There's a Sign out button in Settings, or just say sign me out.

when: my wife uses this phone too
replies: That's fine. Say change account to switch to the other person, or sign me out when you've finished.
Say change account, and the other person can sign in with their own number.
Say finish my account, and I'll tell you what's still needed, like a card or a home address.
I'll check for you. Say finish my account, and I'll go through anything missing.
I'm sorry about that. Please ring us, and a person will put it right. Ask me for the phone number and I'll read it out.
Sorry. Ring us and we'll correct it. Is there any shopping I can help with meanwhile?

when: i've got a new phone number
replies: Please ring us from your new number, and a person will help update your account.
Ring us, and we'll change it safely for you. Ask me for our number if you need it.
Sorry to hear that. Open the website on the new phone and say sign in with your number. If your phone was stolen, please ring us too.
Your account isn't on the phone itself, so sign in on the new one with your number. If it was stolen, ring us and we'll help keep it safe.

when: will you give my number out
will the runner have my number
replies: Your number is kept private. It's only used to sign you in and to call you back if a phone order is cut off. Nobody else sees it.
No Runner ever sees your number, and you never see theirs. All calls go through the app.

when: what to do at the door
why do you ask about the door
replies: When you open your account, I ask what the Runner should do at the door, like knock loudly or wait a moment. It helps them help you.
It's so your Runner knows what suits you at the door. Just tell me in your own words.
Your basket holds the shopping you've chosen. Nothing is bought until I read it back and you say yes.
Everything you ask for goes in your basket first. You can change it any time before you send it.

when: how do i put things in
replies: Just tell me what you need, like two tins of soup. I'll add it and tell you.
Say what you'd like and how many, or tap Add on the shop page.

when: how do i take something out
i changed my mind about something
replies: Say take out, then the item, like take out the biscuits.
Just say remove, and what it is. I'll tell you once it's gone.

when: how do i change how many
replies: Tell me the item and the number you'd like, and I'll put it right. You can also use the plus and minus buttons in the basket.
Say, for example, three tins of beans instead, or change it on the Basket page.
You can take things out one at a time by voice, or use the Basket page to remove them. Then tell me what you'd like instead.
On the Basket page, each item has a button to take it out. Or say remove, and the item.
Your basket stays on this phone while you come and go. Come back whenever you like and carry on.
Yes, take your time. Your basket waits for you on this phone.

when: how do i hear my basket
replies: Just ask what's in my basket, and I'll read it all to you.
Say what's in my basket, and I'll go through each item.
Lovely. Say send my order and pay when you're ready, and I'll read it back with the address before anything is sent.
Thank you. When you're ready, I'll read your basket back and you can say yes.
No rush at all. Tell me the next thing when you're ready.
Take your time. I'll wait for the rest.

when: how much will it cost me
replies: Ask what's the total, and I'll tell you the shopping, the delivery and the whole amount. You pay what the till says.
Each item shows a price with the date it was last checked. Ask me the total any time.

when: why does it show a date
replies: Each price shows when it was last checked, because shop prices change. You always pay exactly what the till says.
The date tells you how fresh the price is. You're charged the receipt, nothing more.

when: i can't find it in the shop
replies: Try saying it another way, like brown bread instead of a brand name. If it's hard to find, say I can't find it anywhere, and a person can look for you.
Let's try different words. And if it's something special, {assistant} Finds It can look in up to three shops.
Tell me the brand when you ask, and I'll look for it. If it's not on the shelf, your Runner will call you before choosing anything else.
Yes, just say the brand with the item. Nothing is swapped without your say.
The size is in the item's name. Ask me what's in my basket, and I'll read each one out in full.
I'll read the full name, which says the size. Ask what's in my basket.
You can tell your Runner anything on the call button once they have your order. And what you said about the door when you joined is shown to them.
Once a Runner has your order, press the green Call button to speak with them.
Your Runner chooses carefully, as they would for themselves. If you have a wish, tell them on the in-app call.
Runners pick with care. You can call them in the app with any wishes once they have your order.

when: how do i place an order
how do i send my order
replies: Tell me what you need. I'll read the basket and the total back, say your address, and send it when you say yes.
Fill your basket by voice or by tapping, then say send. I check everything with you first.
A nearby Runner accepts your order, does your shopping, and brings it to your door. I'll tell you each step.
Your payment is taken, a Runner is sent to the shop, and you can follow it on Your order.
Ask where's my order, and I'll tell you how it's going. You can also look on Your order.
If I said it's sent, it's on its way. Ask where's my order any time.

when: how do i know it's ordered
replies: I tell you when it's sent, and you'll hear or get a notification at each step: paid, a Runner has it, on the way, and delivered.
Yes. You'll be told at each stage, by me or by a notification or text.
You can place another quick order while the first is on its way. Just tell me what you need.
No problem. Tell me what you forgot, and I'll start a new basket for it. The first order carries on.

when: i made a mistake in my order
replies: Once it's sent, the easiest way is to call your Runner with the green Call button and tell them. You can also send a second small order.
Press Call on Your order to speak with your Runner about the change.

when: can i order for next week
replies: Choosing a time isn't available yet; Runners come as soon as they can. For a regular day each week, say set up my weekly shop.
Orders go out straight away for now. If you shop on the same day each week, the weekly shop can help.

when: can i order just one thing
do i have to spend a lot
replies: There's no minimum. You can order just one thing. On pay as you go, a shop of {smallUpTo} or less has the lower delivery of {smallFee}.
No minimum at all. Even one item is fine.

when: what if i go over the limit
replies: If your shopping is more than {maximum}, I'll tell you before you pay: you can take something out, or keep everything and a second Runner brings the rest for an extra delivery.
Above {maximum}, you can keep everything and a second Runner brings the rest.
It's about four or five carrier bags, what one Runner can carry safely on foot or on a bus.
So your Runner can carry everything safely. For a bigger shop, a second Runner can bring the rest.
Your past orders are on the Past orders page. Say same as last time to put the last one back in your basket.
Look on Past orders. Each one has Order these again, and Report a problem.

when: is it going to my house
replies: An order made by voice always goes to your home address. I say the address aloud before every order and wait for your yes.
I'll read the address out before sending, every time. Voice orders always go to your home.

when: why do you read my address
replies: It's to make sure your shopping goes to the right door, every time. Just say yes if it's right.
Saying the address aloud stops shopping going to the wrong place. It only takes a moment.

when: why do i need to touch the screen
why do you need a tap to confirm
replies: For bigger orders, a touch on the screen is needed as well as your voice. It protects you in case someone copies your voice.
It's a safety step for larger amounts, to keep your card safe.

when: another order at the same time
replies: Yes. While one order is on its way, you can still place another. Both stay on Your order.
You can. Just tell me what you need, and the first order carries on.

when: how do i add a card
how do i save my card
where do i put my card
replies: Your card is added once, on the secure card page, and goes straight to the payment company, not to us. A family member or carer can do it for you.
Open the card page from Settings or the basket. The card is saved with the payment company, never with us.

when: can i tell you my card number
